goal: Triage GitHub Dependabot alerts: exposure, the fixed version, breaking-change risk and the order to fix them.
use: Triage GitHub Dependabot alerts: exposure, the fixed version, breaking-change risk and the order to fix them. Use when Dependabot alerts or pull requests need a decision.

steps.note: Read the alerts. Use the Dependabot alerts the user exports or shows: package, version in use, severity, advisory and the fixed version.
Check exposure. For each alert, is the package a direct or transitive dependency? Is the code path reachable from outside? Is it only a development dependency?
Check the fix. Note the first fixed version, whether it is a major, minor or patch change, and whether a lock file or override is needed.
Check breaking-change risk. Read the release notes for the fixed version, and look for changed APIs the code uses.
Rank and group. Order by exposure first, then severity.
Check Dependabot pull requests. Each automated pull request needs its tests run.

protocol.title: Read the alerts
protocol.text: Use the Dependabot alerts the user exports or shows: package, version in use, severity, advisory and the fixed version. Do not invent alerts.

protocol.title: Check exposure
protocol.text: For each alert, is the package a direct or transitive dependency? Is the code path reachable from outside? Is it only a development dependency?

protocol.title: Check the fix
protocol.text: Note the first fixed version, whether it is a major, minor or patch change, and whether a lock file or override is needed.

protocol.title: Check breaking-change risk
protocol.text: Read the release notes for the fixed version, and look for changed APIs the code uses.

protocol.title: Rank and group
protocol.text: Order by exposure first, then severity. Group alerts that one upgrade fixes together.

protocol.title: Check Dependabot pull requests
protocol.text: Each automated pull request needs its tests run. Flag auto-merge on major versions.

protocol.title: Report
protocol.text: A table: alert, package, current version, fixed version, exposure, breaking risk, recommended action. Mark what you could not verify, such as runtime use.
